remarks: Welcome to 314 14th Street! This spacious two-unit property offers approximately 2,212 square feet of living space in Buffalo's West Side neighborhood. An excellent opportunity for owner-occupants or investors, this property features a first-floor unit with 2 bedrooms and 1 full bathroom and a second-floor unit offering 3 bedrooms and 1 full bathroom. Both units feature high ceilings, tall windows, generously sized rooms, and functional layouts. Additional highlights include updated electrical panels, separate gas and electric meters, a full attic, partial basement, driveway, and garage. The property also features a fenced backyard and covered and open porch areas, providing additional outdoor space. Conveniently located near Five Points, Connecticut Street, D'Youville University, shopping, dining, and other neighborhood amenities. A fantastic opportunity to own a versatile two-unit property with plenty of potential in Buffalo's West Side!
